key_themes: US-Iran military tensions spike oil prices above $85, pressuring equities
California wildfire liability bill (SB 492) omits utility protection, crushing PCG and EIX
PayPal deal collapse after Stripe and Advent abandon $53B takeover bid

stocks.reason: Plunged 18% after California lawmakers introduced SB 492 wildfire bill that omits liability shield for investor-owned utilities, prompting multiple analyst downgrades including Mizuho cut to Neutral

Crashed 23% — worst single-day decline since 2001 — as California SB 492 wildfire bill leaves utilities fully exposed to uncapped wildfire liabilities; Mizuho downgraded to Neutral with $70 target (from $86)
Sank alongside PCG and EIX as California SB 492 wildfire legislation omits liability protection for all investor-owned utilities in the state
Fell ~13% after Bloomberg reported Advent International and Stripe abandoned their $53B ($60.50/share) takeover bid; Mizuho cut target to $51, Loop Capital to $50
Dropped 8% after Elon Musk announced via social media that SpaceX will cast natural-gas turbine blades and vanes in-house, raising demand concerns for specialized suppliers
Fell 13% after announcing CEO Stephan Gratziani will depart effective October 31, with CFO John DeSimone named interim CEO; leadership uncertainty hits already-pressured stock
Rose ~5% after reporting preliminary Q2 results showing a loss of $0.36/share, beating estimates of -$0.42; also amended convertible note exchange capping dilution with $358M cash payment
Gained 4% after raising full-year EPS guidance to $10.65-$10.75 (from $9.90-$10.10) and revenue outlook to $7.2-$7.3B following strong quarterly results
Rose with energy sector as US-Iran military exchange drove crude oil above $85/barrel, lifting Treasury yields and boosting integrated oil majors
Rallied ~4% after Baird upgraded to Outperform from Neutral with $150 target (from $120), citing margin recovery potential and Fendt brand market share gains pushing EPS toward $10 by 2027
Jumped ~4% after Baird upgraded to Outperform from Neutral with $800 target (from $640), calling Deere the "cleanest setup" in ag equipment on high North America row-crop exposure
Gained on dual analyst upgrades: Rothschild/Redburn raised to Buy with $400 target; HSBC upgraded to Buy with $366 target, both citing AI product pipeline as "operational turning point"
